Pancakes for Dinner

Pancakes are too good to stay stuck at breakfast. They take ten minutes, use things you already have in the kitchen, and nobody at the table ever complains. You can go sweet with syrup and berries, or savory with cheese, bacon, and a fried egg on top. After a long day, a warm stack feels like a small party on a plate. Dinner should be easy and fun, and pancakes are both.

It runs on your own OpenAI API key, and it only works once a key is connected. Create a new key just for this, set a low spending limit first, and revoke the key when you are done. The prototype sends requests as you type, select, and drag, so what a session costs is unknown.
